Synopsis:
    Emmitt Smith and business partner David Mosley, via 4 13 Solutions Inc., are accused in a Delaware Chancery Court lawsuit of fraudulently misappropriating a $2.5M loan from Kituwah LLC (Eastern Band of Cherokee Indians) intended for the "Project Exodus" solar farm. Kituwah alleges the funds were redirected to pay Wilson Holdings in a Ponzi-like scheme, with repayment overdue since Feb. 1, 2024. The suit seeks $2.5M+ in damages, citing fraudulent inducement, breach of fiduciary duty, and breach of contract.
